trigger_condition: user types a query, then quickly retypes before the first debounced fetch resolves
potential_consequence: stale slower response overwrites newer search results, showing wrong/outdated user list

trigger_condition: popup reopened rapidly for a different assistant before the previous getSharedWith resolves
guard_snippet: track a request id or assistant id per fetch and ignore stale resolutions
potential_consequence: sharedWith list from the previous assistant briefly or permanently overwrites the new assistant's list

trigger_condition: handleRemove called twice quickly for the same user (double click) before removingId re-renders disable the button
guard_snippet: if (removingId === userId) return; at top of handleRemove
potential_consequence: duplicate DELETE requests fired; optimistic re-add on failure could race and leave inconsistent UI

trigger_condition: handleShare succeeds but includes a user id no longer selectable (e.g. removed from options mid-flight)
guard_snippet: none needed if selectedUsers is the sole source of truth; verify backend rejects unknown ids gracefully
potential_consequence: partial share failure reported as full success since catch is all-or-nothing, no per-user result

trigger_condition: assistantsStore.shareWith partially succeeds server-side then throws (e.g. one of several user_ids invalid)
guard_snippet: surface which user ids failed instead of a single generic toaster.error
potential_consequence: user believes entire share action failed though some users were actually added

trigger_condition: assistant prop transitions from non-null to null while popup remains visible (e.g. parent clears it)
guard_snippet: guard render body / early return null when assistant is null while visible
potential_consequence: Popup still renders with stale/empty state and footer Save button enabled despite no assistant

trigger_condition: onChange fires with an id not present in searchOptions (e.g. selection made from a stale render)
guard_snippet: already returns [] via flatMap guard — but silently drops the selection with no user feedback
potential_consequence: user-visible chip silently disappears from the selection with no explanation

trigger_condition: assistant object reference changes every render (e.g. parent creates new object each render) though id is same
guard_snippet: depend on assistant.id in the effect, not the whole assistant object
potential_consequence: getSharedWith re-fetches on every render, causing request storms

trigger_condition: userStore.user is still null/loading when sidebar first renders for an owned, non-global assistant
guard_snippet: gate rendering on user load state, not just created_by?.id === undefined
potential_consequence: Shared status field is hidden for the true owner until auth/user store finishes loading

trigger_condition: user is undefined during initial auth load (same pattern as sidebar)
guard_snippet: treat isOwned as undefined/loading rather than false until user is known
potential_consequence: StatusLabel briefly renders nothing for the assistant owner's own cards while user store loads

trigger_condition: Share action gated on canEditAssistant (write ability), not on true ownership, for is_global assistants
potential_consequence: non-owner editors of marketplace/global assistants can open a collaboration-share popup that is not meaningful for global assistants

trigger_condition: getSharedWith response body is not JSON (e.g. 204/empty body or HTML error page from a proxy)
guard_snippet: catch response.json() parse errors separately and still return []
potential_consequence: unhandled JSON parse rejection surfaces as the same generic console.error/empty-array path, masking real cause but also fine at UI level — however a non-2xx with skipErrorHandling may not throw before json(), causing parse throw

trigger_condition: query string contains characters requiring encoding beyond encodeURIComponent defaults, or empty string query
guard_snippet: skip the request or return [] when query is empty/whitespace-only before calling api.get
potential_consequence: unnecessary network call with q= empty, wasted request each keystroke edge (mitigated by handleFilter’s own empty-check, but store has no defense if called directly)

trigger_condition: removeShare called with an empty userIds array
guard_snippet: if (!userIds.length) return; at top of removeShare/shareWith
potential_consequence: pointless DELETE/POST request with empty user_ids sent to backend

trigger_condition: assistant.is_global true and isOwned false/undefined (global assistant viewed by non-owner)
guard_snippet: none needed — GLOBAL bypasses the isOwned check; confirm getStatusText(GLOBAL) always used, StatusType.OWNED now unreachable when !isOwned filters first
potential_consequence: StatusType.OWNED branch in getStatusText/getStatusIcon is now dead code since isOwned=false always returns null before reaching it, and isOwned=true never yields SHARED-less OWNED distinctly from NOT_SHARED text

trigger_condition: req.query.q is an array (repeated ?q=a&q=b) or contains regex-special characters for json-server's search
potential_consequence: middleware throws on q.toLowerCase() since array has no such usable form as string, breaking mock search endpoint

guard_snippet: try/catch already exists only in ShareAssistantPopup caller; store methods themselves throw unguarded
potential_consequence: consistent with caller try/catch, but any other future caller of shareWith/removeShare without try/catch gets unhandled rejection
